note: Owner HugoXK keeps repository merge authority. Reviewer work is hosted by the HugoXK-bot account (hugo2001xk@gmail.com), and a T2/T3 PASS must be written and posted by that login. The author of the tip may never PASS it — the bot reviews human- and bot-authored tips alike — and this policy carries no self-review waiver. `writers` decides who may author a verdict; `authors` decides who may be named as a pull request's author. The policy is read from the base branch so a pull request cannot weaken its own gate, and `authors` falls back to `writers` on a base branch that predates the split.
